definitions.explanation: An artificial body of water for swimming.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}にプールがあります。
examples.english: There is a pool at school.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}はプールに{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the pool in summer.

notes:
プール is a loanword from English "pool."

TYPES:
- {室内|しつない}プール (indoor pool)
- {屋外|おくがい}プール (outdoor pool)
- {温水|おんすい}プール (heated pool)

RELATED:
- {泳|およ}ぐ (to swim)
- {水泳|すいえい} (swimming)
- {水着|みずぎ} (swimsuit)
